name: gaming
description: Game library and device workflows: verified onboarding, non-destructive sync, device snapshots, emulator settings and cheats, sharing one profile across hosts.

skills.name: setup
skills.shortDescription: Create or update the shared gaming profile
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $setup to set up or update my gaming profile.

skills.name: onboard
skills.shortDescription: Add verified games, art and manuals to the library

skills.name: sync
skills.shortDescription: Back up the library and update devices safely
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $sync to back up my game library and update my devices.

skills.name: backup
skills.shortDescription: Snapshot a device's emulator setup and saves
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $backup to snapshot my device's emulator setup and saves.

skills.name: configure
skills.shortDescription: Change emulator and frontend settings safely
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $configure to change this emulator or frontend setting.

skills.name: cheats

interface.shortDescription: Game library, device and emulator workflows.
interface.longDescription: Gaming keeps a verified, system-first game library, backs it up without deletions, snapshots devices, records each device's frontend setup as a baseline, and handles emulator settings and cheats. One profile shared by Claude Code and Codex remembers libraries, devices and how to reach them.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me manage my game library and devices.
